scope: 12 Blog plus 5 Research compared with the repository title/topic corpus and with one another
method: Manual topic, central-argument, section-sequence, and worked-example review, supplemented by exact-paragraph and five-word-shingle checks. A distinct slug or low shingle score was not treated as sufficient.
priorCorpusResult: No October 5 item repeats a prior article's reader decision, central argument, or worked example. Adjacent prior subjects were narrowed to a new operational decision rather than renamed.

entries.topic: meeting impact after a civil time-rule change
entries.argument: recover the intended time anchor before proposing bounded corrections
entries.workedExample: New York-Manila series plus Arizona travel exception
entries.collisionDecision: Distinct from prior overlap-hours/calendar-hold work and from Research recurring-series change control, which addresses edit blast radius.

entries.argument: preserve evidence and split security review from the business deadline
entries.collisionDecision: Distinct from prior phishing escalation and forwarding-loop articles; it governs file activation and parallel operational routing.

entries.argument: use one restricted traveler profile and stop before financial commitment on unresolved fields
entries.workedExample: employee uses a short name but profile has two given names
entries.collisionDecision: Distinct from itinerary risk and Research fare-hold expiry; neither addresses identity-field provenance.

entries.argument: separate working sources, released copy, and consequence-based late-change lanes
entries.workedExample: finance chart changes after two external advisers receive R1
entries.collisionDecision: Distinct from prior meeting context packs and document cleanup; the decision is partial-distribution supersession.

entries.argument: map relationships and downstream IDs before a reversible owner-approved merge
entries.workedExample: acquired companies share a domain but retain separate contracts
entries.collisionDecision: Distinct from prior CRM field-change work and Research bulk-export control; it resolves entity identity and merge effects.

entries.argument: classify a source's job and search for successors or contradiction by claim
entries.workedExample: old remote-work principle paired with a changeable product default
entries.collisionDecision: Distinct from prior source-quality/provenance work because it chooses current fitness by claim volatility.

entries.argument: test hidden surfaces and the exact recipient artifact, not visual masking
entries.workedExample: proposal names remain copyable beneath black rectangles and in metadata
entries.collisionDecision: Distinct from comment-author cleanup and pre-read versioning; it verifies irreversible content removal.

entries.argument: separate routine, decision, and emergency coverage and establish explicit stop states
entries.workedExample: legal approval and production credential owners overlap on leave before launch
entries.collisionDecision: Distinct from dependency registers and handoff logs; it audits transferable authority during absence.

entries.argument: keep merchant, settlement, and reporting stages separate with reproducible rate direction
entries.workedExample: EUR hotel, USD card posting and fee, PHP reporting
entries.collisionDecision: Distinct from prior expense-category conflict work; it resolves rate/date arithmetic without choosing policy.

entries.argument: classify who caused each change before applying recruiter-owned rules
entries.workedExample: two second changes, one including a prior panel-caused move
entries.collisionDecision: Distinct from prior panel substitution and Research timezone confirmation; it addresses equitable rule application.

entries.argument: separate purpose, consent, temporary requests and delivery states before outreach
entries.workedExample: CRM says phone, ticket says email, latest message says no calls this week
entries.collisionDecision: Distinct from prior channel-switch work; it reconciles simultaneous system-of-record conflicts.

entries.argument: reproduce periods and publish a visible continuity decision
entries.collisionDecision: Distinct from provisional-data labeling and reporting SOPs; it proves semantic series breaks.

entries.argument: compare read-only rule records with an approved baseline while reserving incident actions
entries.workedExample: approved ticket route, expired handoff and unexplained external destination test set
entries.collisionDecision: Distinct from Blog suspicious attachments and prior forwarding-loop diagnosis: persistent configuration governance, not message/file handling.

entries.argument: verify scope, time anchor, exceptions, audience and recovery before editing
entries.workedExample: synthetic cross-zone series with modified and cancelled occurrences
entries.collisionDecision: Distinct from Blog time-rule audit: controlled series mutation rather than detecting meetings affected by rule changes.

entries.argument: bind export population, purpose, fields, destination, retention and deletion evidence
entries.workedExample: closed test populations with excessive fields and destination constraints
entries.collisionDecision: Distinct from Blog merge evidence and prior field-quality work: governs data extraction and custody.

entries.argument: record supplier and internal clocks, terms, revalidation and a safe no-response default
entries.workedExample: free hold, paid freeze and auto-charge option test matrix
entries.collisionDecision: Distinct from Blog traveler-name review and prior connection-risk article: time-bounded commercial option control.

entries.argument: record one reproducible instant with named zone, applicable offset and privacy-minimal confirmation
entries.workedExample: Manila-New York transition, travel and wrong-device-zone cases
entries.collisionDecision: Distinct from Blog reschedule consistency: conversion accuracy rather than permission to change appointments.
